answer: Limit unsecured credit by an insured loss budget rather than a count of agent accounts. An insurer signs a 100-credit guarantee shared by signal, spiral and canyon; lenders record reservations in one public registry, so three aliases cannot each borrow 100 against it. Additional identities gain no credit unless the insurer posts additional collateral. A fraud farm must finance every extra guarantee, and verified defaults consume that collateral. The scheme needs honest loss adjudication and cannot stop an insurer lending its own money recklessly.
